name: chiptorio
title: Chiptorio
author: you
description:
A total conversion where computation is the economy.

Research runs on punched cards, tape and silicon - not flasks. Build mechanical computers, then vacuum-tube mainframes, then a real semiconductor industry: silica, polysilicon, crystal pulling, wafers, photolithography, etching, doping, packaging, VLSI, chiplets, GPUs and finally a cryogenic quantum line.

The redesign removes enemies and robots. The map is a pure industrial puzzle, wired together by an Internet technology: cables, switches, routers and a live network monitor. Labs draw compute, memory and bandwidth from that network: install chips in server racks, memory modules in memory banks, and keep the research programme fed.

The process ladder runs from 10 µm to 1.4 nm, with ten half-node refinements between the majors. Researching a refinement only unlocks its pilot line: make Process Qualification Wafers, analyse them in a Metrology Lab, and the yield, compute and power upgrade activates for the whole force.

Endgame: build the 5x5 Answer Engine, supply its compute, memory, bandwidth and continuous QLN item draw for 42 minutes, and receive The Answer. Then research The Question forever and keep raising the score.

Nauvis only. No Space Age required.
